sources.title: Scottcjn/open-xdna: Open-source bring-up - GitHub
sources.snippet: The first-generation XDNA1 NPU — "Phoenix" / "Hawk Point" — in millions of Ryzen laptops, brought up on Linux with 100% open source. Models running on the silicon. Custom vector kernels hand-authored in the AIE ISA. FastFlowLM and AMD Lemonade — the stacks everyone points to for "LLMs on the Ryzen AI NPU" — support XDNA2 only.

sources.title: AMD XDNA - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: XDNA is a microarchitecture for deep learning processor developed by AMD. It is designed to handle Machine learning (ML)-related tasks, such as artificial intelligence (AI) software. It is based on Xilinx technology, which AMD acquired in 2022. XDNA-based silicon designs are incorporated into the company's Ryzen AI -branded processors where it supplements the Zen CPU and RDNA GPU on the same ...
